_comment: Asset Store catalog. Each pack's content lives under packs/<id>/ mirroring INSTALL-RELATIVE paths (e.g. packs/tac/Mods/Tac/scripts.vol installs to <game>/Mods/Tac/scripts.vol). tools/publish-store.ps1 in the native repo validates this file, hashes the content, regenerates store.json, and commits. Adding an asset never touches the game manifest or bumps the game version.

packs.title: Tribes Aerial Combat (TAC) 1.41
packs.description: Team Aerial Combat - teamwork-required flight combat by the TPG team (2001). Full client and server: 29 missions (CTF, C&H, TDM, D&D, F&R), custom skins and sounds, and the complete server-side scripts so you can host it. Launch with -mod Tac or use the toggle below.
packs.author: TAC Development Team

packs.title: Red Moon RPG (RMRPG)
packs.description: Red Moon RPG - the Tribes RPG variant that stacks on top of the base RPG mod: its own missions, skins, GUI and server scripts. Needed to join Red Moon servers. v8 adds the chocobo mounts (8 models and their 7 colour skins), 13 missing armour and robe skins, 8 missing terrain sets, and refreshes every script to the live server's build. Launch with -mod rpg -mod rmrpg (RMRPG stacks on RPG) or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Red Moon RPG team

packs.title: Star Wars RPG (SWRPG)
packs.description: Star Wars Tribes RPG by Hazor and team - an RPG mod set in the Star Wars universe, built on the Star Wars TC 2.0 art and sounds: skins, models, terrain and scripts. v2 adds the recovered Tatooine server mission, so you can host the real map locally, plus 8 recovered robe and armor skins. Launch with -mod SWRPG or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Hazor / SWRPG team

packs.title: Star Wars TC 2.0 (full)
packs.description: The complete Star Wars total conversion: eight Star Wars maps (Dantooine, Tatooine, Battle of Hoth, Yavin Base, Mos Eisley, Mos Espa, Sarlaac Pit, Sith Knight), custom vehicles, weapons, sounds and voices. Every texture AI-upscaled 4x and palettized, legacy .vol archives converted to .zip, and deduplicated against base Tribes so you download the mod rather than another copy of the game. Launch with -mod StarWars.
packs.author: Star Wars TC team

packs.title: Annihilation
packs.description: Annihilation - the classic Tribes total conversion, both halves in one download: deployable turrets, jump pads, blast walls and force fields, twelve turret types, tanks and dropships, duels and arena modes, its own bots and admin suite, plus 643 missions, the community skin set and its HUDs. Host it or join with it. Launch with -mod TotalAnnihilation or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Annihilation team

packs.title: GoldenEye 007 + Perfect Dark Maps
packs.description: Nine maps recreated from GoldenEye 007 and Perfect Dark -- Facility, Complex, Caves, Egyptian, Temple, Library, Basement, Stack and Grid -- with flags, objectives and inventory stations for two teams. All 3,624 textures AI-upscaled 4x and palettized. Plays in base Tribes: no mod to select, the maps just appear.
packs.author: Map pack by the GoldenEye007 Tribes project; textures upscaled for Modern Tribes

packs.title: Starsiege: Full Conversion
packs.description: The complete Starsiege (1999) asset corpus converted to this engine and upscaled -- terrain, interiors, sounds, fonts and media, mounted as a mod. Launch with the toggle below to explore Dynamix's other universe inside Tribes.
packs.author: Dynamix (conversion: Modern Tribes project)

packs.title: Delta Air Force
packs.description: Modern air combat for Tribes: attack aircraft, helicopters and tanks you actually pilot, plus 20 mission maps built around them. A classic community mod preserved from the repack lineage. Launch with -mod DeltaAirForce or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Delta Air Force team

packs.title: HD Normal Maps -- Full Coverage
packs.description: 5,756 additional normal maps that fill the gaps the per-terrain-pack sets leave. The HD terrain packs each carry normal maps for their own tiles, but most of the game's other surfaces -- base interiors, mod art, skins, effects -- had none, so bump lighting simply did not apply to them. This pack completes the coverage, so surfaces light with real depth everywhere instead of only on packaged terrain. Needs $pref::gpuNormalMap on (it is on by default). Purely visual: no gameplay change, no mod to select, and nothing depends on it.
packs.author: Generated for Modern Tribes with DeepBump

packs.title: Upscaled Player Skin Pack
packs.description: 403 community skin packs from the classic Tribes era, AI-upscaled and added to your skin list. Every texture was run through the same 4xNomos8kDAT model used for the rest of Modern Tribes, resolved to 512 and palettized, so armour and emblems stay sharp up close without the download that full 4x would cost. Installs into base\Skins and appears in the skin selector -- no mod to launch, nothing else changes.
packs.author: Skins by their original community authors; upscaled for Modern Tribes

packs.title: Elite Renegades
packs.description: Elite Renegades 1.1b, Fire Team Alpha's classic Renegades ruleset as carried on by the Temples of Syrinx: reworked armours, weapons and stations, team-kill and station-camping limits, name bans, vote and public-admin controls and the BWadmin observer tools for shoutcasting, all on the stock maps. Ported to Modern Tribes by a community player. Launch with -mod EliteRenegades or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Fire Team Alpha / Temples of Syrinx (Modern Tribes port: community)

packs.title: Tribes 2 Armors, Props and Buildings
packs.description: The Tribes 2 art, converted for Modern Tribes: the five player armors (light, medium and heavy male, light and medium female) replace the stock armors while installed, with their Tribes 2 animations plus the stock crouch, throw, sign and pose clips transferred onto them; 242 props and vehicles as new shapes (t2_ names, for mappers' datablocks); and all 324 Tribes 2 buildings as native interiors that appear in the mission editor's Interiors palette on every map. Installs loose under base\ (every file carries a t2_ prefix or a Tribes 2 building name) -- no mod to launch, nothing else changes, and Remove restores the stock armors. Buildings are used by placing them in a mission; no map ships with them yet. Known gaps: the converted armors lack the two tumble clips (as stock heavies and mediums do), buildings carry detail level 0 only, and the very largest bases use a box collision.
packs.author: Dynamix (Tribes 2, 2001); converted with tools\t2port from the Modern Tribes repo
